requirements: R1: Patch task status synchronization logic to prevent unmerged closed PRs from erroneously marking tasks as done

slices.title: Patch task status sync logic for unmerged PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the patch for GitHub status sync, I want to use atomically-guarded updates and avoid false 'done' transitions for unmerged closed PRs, so that task state accurately reflects reality.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a linked GitHub PR is closed without being merged
When the system synchronizes the internal task state
Then the task status must not become done and any state change must use an atomically-guarded update
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done status transitions due to unmerged closed PRs to 0%
